_why: The words of the OWNER-APPROVED interim site (Orb's decision, 2026-10-18, homework 36; Legal's addendum 11, RL-161, gave the words; tools/site.json interim.owner). tools/site-interim.mjs renders them as the gate of /play/ and the About page. Legal's ruling-based file is tools/site-interim.json.

record._why: The interim's own record, kept where it is whether the site is online or not (tools/flash/nightly-seeds.mjs reads the take-down limit here when the site is offline or a pin is given, never from tools/site.json): who decided, Legal's ruling, and the limit. A new scene over this on the primary reading (flashes in the worst second) is the take-down trigger (Legal addendum 11, RL-161).

about.heading: About this build, licenses and privacy

blocks.p: Orb Combat EX is a one-person project. Orb directs it, and AI tools write the code and draft the art, animation, dialogue and design documents. Nothing in the game is generated by AI while you play: the fight director and the world are ordinary game code.

This game collects and sends no personal data. The web version is hosted on GitHub Pages, which keeps its own server logs. The feedback button copies a report to your clipboard for you to paste to Orb; nothing is sent by the game.
